title: Fake official accounts in practice
intro: Check the source before you trust or share. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Message from Ministry of Social Services | Official
decisions.prompt: The channel name looks official. But where does the link go?

artifact.name: Ministry of Social Services | Official
body: Dear citizen! Every family is granted a one-off state payment of 300 AZN.
To receive it, enter your card details today: sxn-yardim.example.net/qeydiyyat

decisions.explain: The address is not the ministry's site, and a report gets the channel closed faster.

decisions.title: Message from Department group
decisions.prompt: A colleague posted it, but no source is given. What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Department group
body: Forwarded. Urgent! From tomorrow civil servants' salary cards are being replaced. Update your details so the old card is not blocked: maas-kart-yeni.example.net

decisions.explain: Check an internal decision with an internal source, on a number you know.

decisions.title: Message from Head of Office (new number)
decisions.prompt: A familiar title, but a number you do not know. What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Head of Office (new number)
body: Hello. This is my new number. I'm in a meeting and can't call.
Send me a copy of this morning's official letter here, urgently.

decisions.explain: Always check a new number through a channel you already know.

decisions.title: Ministry's list of its accounts
decisions.prompt: You opened the ministry's site yourself. Is this page official or fake?

artifact.title: Ministry of Social Services: our official accounts
body: We never ask for card details in messages or comments.

decisions.explain: This is the ministry's own site. Take the list of official accounts from a page like this.

decisions.title: Contest page with an extra word
decisions.prompt: A friend shared this page. Is it official or fake?

artifact.title: Ministry of Social Services: 1000 free laptops!
body: Sign up today. Sign-up fee 5 AZN.

decisions.explain: The extra word at the end is a typical sign of a fake. The official address is sxn.resmi.
